exercises.title: 7. Pratique: Concessive clauses — although, despite, whereas

items.prompt: ___ her vast experience, she found the political landscape at Czarnikow difficult to navigate.
items.hintAfterError: Depois da lacuna vem um substantivo ('her vast experience'), não uma oração com verbo.

items.prompt: ___ the previous director was hands-on, the new one prefers to delegate.
___ the listening tour took three weeks, it proved to be the most valuable part of the onboarding.
___ careful preparation, the first quarter included several avoidable mistakes.
items.hintAfterError: 'In spite' precisa de 'of'; 'Although' precisa de uma oração com verbo.

items.prompt: ___ junior hires need process training, senior hires need relationship maps.
items.hintAfterError: Compara dois grupos diferentes em orações completas.
